rationale: The original short premise of a rejection off session VWAP ($192.94) has failed, with price climbing steadily over the last five 1-minute candles to reclaim VWAP and reach the 5-minute 9-EMA ($194.28). With the current ask at $194.70—already above the $194.50 invalidation level on a wide 46.8 bps spread—closing immediately avoids an imminent stop-out while the wide spread and heavy gap-down overhang make flipping to long unattractive.
